name: EdGlantine-PS5

threadPlacement: Six distinct guest physical cores + separate GPU; validated CPUID only, OS fallback

eglantineAdaptations: Batch large-page cache invalidation by contiguous ranges
Reset device page continuity on map/unmap and cut preceding runs
Reject truncated Vulkan pipeline cache headers; preserve PS5 atomic writer and old valid cache on failure
NX2 operation-mode refresh event and actual settings-change propagation
Loose dump NACP/icon sidecars and display version with documented RomFS heuristic
ASTC written-layer uploads from existing dirty-page tracking; bounded batches and BC/rescaled exclusions
Release CPU upload scratch above 64 MiB; upload volume counters
RET R0/R55 regression tests adapted to existing strict return linkage validation
rejectedAdaptations: QMD history eviction: replays completed descriptors on action 2; regression caught by native_semaphore test
genericHostSuite: Not validated: desktop fastmem assumptions and Catch2 abort; log retained
shaderFixes: Validate barrier cancellation paths and chains
Reject WARPSYNC with a mismatched reconvergence target
Semantic tests for vector RZ stores, cube-array LOD zero, and unsigned atomic MIN
